h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Raiganj

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Raiganj

c: For a park committee or school in Raiganj, an open air gym is one of the simpler public amenities to add. It needs no power supply, no staff to run it and very little upkeep once it is in the ground. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor fitness equipment at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and supplies it to towns across West Bengal, including Raiganj in Uttar Dinajpur district.

The distance is about 1,710 km, so we plan the order carefully before anything leaves the factory. You share the size of the area, a few photos and the kind of people who will use it. We send back a layout drawing showing each machine and the clear space around it. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture, dispatch by road and install through our team or a dealer in the east.

richText.heading: Planning for heavy rain and soft ground

c: North Bengal gets a long, wet monsoon, and low-lying open ground in Raiganj can hold water for days. Lift the gym area slightly above the surrounding level and give it a gentle slope so rain runs off. A concrete or rubber-floored base keeps the footing firm, and grouting each post into that base holds the machines steady in soft soil.

items.q: Do you deliver outdoor gym equipment as far as Raiganj?
items.a: Yes. We deliver anywhere in India by road from our Vasai factory, and installation is done by our team or a dealer in the eastern region.

items.q: How do you plan an order without visiting the site?
items.a: You send photos, the length and width of the area and details of who will use it. We prepare a layout drawing with the machines and safe clear space marked, and you approve it before we manufacture.

items.q: Will the machines rust in the monsoon?
items.a: The frames are galvanised pipe and many parts are roto-moulded plastic, both suited to wet weather. Regular wiping and the maintenance steps we share at handover help them last longer.
